en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a school campus consisting of several wooden buildings around an open grassy area with trees and footpaths. A central two‑storey building with many windows and a small portico has a flagpole in front flying a Nordic‑style flag. On the left is another smaller wooden house-like building; on the right stands a barn‑ or hall‑like structure. The setting appears rural and peaceful. The caption identifying the place is printed at the lower left, and a serial number is printed at the lower right.
